_comment: Jurisdiction adoption metadata — edition facts only, no code text. Sources: ICC/state legislative websites (public record). Update as states adopt new editions.

CA.notes: California Building Code (CBC) amends IBC; seismic zone varies by county

TX.notes: Adopted by local jurisdictions; some municipalities use older editions

NY.notes: New York City uses its own NYC Building Code (2014 base)

FL.notes: Florida Building Code; high-velocity hurricane zones (HVHZ) additional requirements

WA.notes: Washington State Building Code; seismic zone varies by county

OR.notes: Oregon Residential Specialty Code; seismic zone D in Portland area

CO.notes: Local adoption varies; high-altitude and wildfire provisions apply

AZ.notes: Statewide minimum; local jurisdictions may adopt newer editions

IL.notes: Chicago uses its own Chicago Building Code; elsewhere IBC/IRC
